title: Take better care of elderly, PWDs amid Super El Niño

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Quezon City councilor Alfred Vargas on Tuesday called for special care for senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PWDs) amid the effects of the Super El Niño, particularly the drought expected to hit Metro Manila by January. Vargas issued the call as he urged Quezon City residents and barangay officials to prepare their households early for the effects of El Niño. According to Vargas, families and caregivers should ensure that seniors and PWDs are in well-ventilated spaces and hydrated at all times.
